tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don 'khrigs chags su bkod pa phal sreg dang bcas pa bzhugs/
༄༅/ /'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don 'khrigs chags su bkod pa phal sreg dang bcas pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don 'khrigs chags su bkod pa phal sreg dang bcas pa bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra bhai ra wā ye/ 'dir 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ngag 'don bya tshul 'jug pa bde ba zhig bri bar bya'o/ /de la sngar cho ga ma byas pa'i gzhir/ sngon du sa spyang dgos pas/ grub na rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas par bsgoms nas/ sa spyad pa rgyas par bya zhing*/ de tsam ma grub na/ rang 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom zhing rdo rje gsum gyis sa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyang bar gyur bar bsams pa'am/ 'dod na las sngags brjod de thal ba yungs dkar dri chu sogs kyis sbyang ba dang yang na las sngags brgya rtsa brjod pas kyang rung ste/ kun rdzob kyi dag pa dang*/ sa'i nyes skyon thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong pa'i bdag nyid du gyur par bsam pa ni don dam pa'i sbyang ba'i/ /sa gzhi rang bzhin gyis dkar ba'am/ sa dkar po byugs pa la thog mar dbus btsal nas/ tshangs zur gyi thig btab ste/ de nas thig skud khru phyed pa zhig gis dbus nas zlum bor bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas phyed pa de la sor bzhi bsnan nas/ des dbus nas zlum por bskor bar bya'o/ kha khyer logs su bskor na sor bzhi bsnams nas bya'o/ / yang dbus nas sor bzhis zlum skor bya ste lte ba'o/ /thabs kyi dpangs su sor bcu gnyis dang*/ kha khyer sor bzhi pa gud du btags na legs/ kha khyer la 'khor lo'am rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor bar bya zhing*/ zlum thig phyi ma'i phyogs bzhi nas sor gnyis re dor nas gru bzhir gdab cing gru bzhi pa'i zur du/ zla ba phyed pa'i steng du rdo rje rtse gsum pa phyed pas mtshan pa dang*/ thabs kyi dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa srid tu sor brgyad pa/ dpangs su sor gcig pa bya'o/ /de nas zlum thig nang ma'i steng nas bud shing skam po srog chags med cing dri zhim pas zlum por brtsigs te/

bud shing brtsigs pa las dkar pos byugs shing*/ phyi rol du ba'i lci ba dang*/ bdud rtsi dkar po dang ldan pa'i dri dkar pos byugs la/ me tog dkar po bsil mar bkram par bya'o/ /de nas chu bzhi dang bzed zhal gsum/ bsang gtor gyi ku sha'i chun po dang bcas pa/ maṇa dzi la sogs pa'i steng du g.yon du dgod par bya zhing*/ bsang chu'am/ las bum yang g.yon du dgod las bum pa bsgrubs pa yod na/ bsang chu bsgrub mi dgos shing*/ med na bsgrub dgos pas/ bsgrub tshul ni/ snod gtsang mar chu gtsang ma la dri bzang btab la bzhag ste/ de nyid spos kyis bdug cing*/ khaṅga dh+rika brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ bdun tsam bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ thog mar g.yas su bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i rim pa bzhin las bsgrigs/ de'i nang rol du 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i mchod rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du bkod pa'i mthar 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i gtor ma yang bsham/ de'i nang rol du 'jig rten las 'das pas 'bul ba'i mchod rdzas chu bzhi ma gtogs pa rnams rim pa bzhin bkod/ mar khu dang*/ dgang blugs dang*/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ nang mchod rnams mdun du bzhag cing*/ me gso ba'i chas dang thab kyi kha khyer la 'god rgyu'i ku sha yang sta gon byas la/ rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod kyis bran par bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyi stan la pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa tsam bya'o/ /de ltar cho ga'i yan lag rnams tshogs par byas la/ bsgrub mchod la sogs pa'am skabs gzhan yang rung ste/ sngar sgrub thabs bsgom pa'i cho ga'i rgyun yin na des chog /min na nang mchod byin rlabs nas bzung ste/ nyer bsdu'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms te/ 'jam zhing bde ba'i stan ha cang mthon po ba yin pa la/ rkang pa gnyis cung zad brkyang la/ rkang mthil gnyis sbyar ba pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis/ kha shar la phyogs pas 'dug ste/

smra ba gzhan bcad/ rdor dril byin rlabs byas pa nas bzung ste sbyin sreg ma tshar bar lag pa rdol dril dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /de nas cho ga dngos la 'jug pa ni/ rdo rje ni thabs dang dril bu ni shes rab ste/ de gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /snyam du bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dha badz+ra sa ma ye/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dhā ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod de lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis thugs kar bzung/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ zhes brjod de/ lag pa g.yon ba'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis dril bu g.yon gyi dkur kha gyen la bstan te bzung*/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /snyam du bsam la/ hūṃ sems can rmongs nang 'bral ba yi/ /rdo rje gsol ba mdzes pa yis/ /rnam thar chos kyi bya ba ste/ /spro dang bcas pas rdo rje bzung*/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ho ho ho/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje gsor bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje g.yas pa'i dkur bzung ba'am gsor la/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta/ nā da swa bhā we/ badz+ra sa twa hrīḥd ya/ san+to ṣa ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ho ho ho/ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing dril bu ni nang gi phyogs brgyad du lce bskyod pas dkrol bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pas las bum gyi kha rgyan na/ ku shas las bum gyi chu'am/ bsang su nas blangs te/ thab dang*/ mchod rdzas sogs dang*/ rang la'ang rang gi g.yon ngos nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor du bsang gtor lan gsum bya zhing*/ sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de rjais lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs nas kyang g.yas skor du lan gsum bya zhing*/ las sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de nas slar yang me lha'i mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod gtor la/

las sngags brjod cing*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+re swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhas zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams/ rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ argaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ argaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma ṇaṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ku ṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai we ta/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ parasha/ rnams bcug ste/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ yang na gsang gtor zhal bsil zhes kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de/ yam shing dang*/ mar khu sogs bsreg rdzas rnams la reg cing*/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod de rdzas rnams bkru bar bsam/ 'dir kha cig oṃ oṃ swāhā/ zhes zer/ oṃ āḥswāhās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swāhās mar khu/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhās 'bru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās/ de dag las gzhan pa'i rdzas rnams ky-i mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i nyes skyon thams cad byang zhing dag nas bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gyur bar bsam/ de nas shing 'o ma can las byung ba'am/ gtsub shing las byung ba'am/ me tha mal pa'am/ /dgon pa'i me gang yang rung ba/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod de snod du bzhag la zhun mar gyi sgron me sbar zhing*/ las sngags brjod la bsang chu dang nang mchod kyis me de la g.yas skor du lan gsum gsum bsang ngo*/ /de nas sgron me de gtsang zhing shin tu skam pa'i rtswa'i chun po dang bcas pas thab kyi nang du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing gzi brjid bskyed/ hūṃ/ zhes brjaud cing rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/

las sngags brjod la/ mar khu blugs gzer bdun gyis kyang me gso/ /de nas ku sha rnams lag tu bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes lan bdun brjod la ku sha byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhig dge /tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*/ /bdag gi bgeg rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod nas ku sha sngo ljang dri ma med pa ma chags shing 'dam ma grugs pa ha cang yang mi ring ba gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs pa rang gi g.yon ngos nas brtsams te thab kyi kha khyer la rang kha gang la bltas pa'i ngos la shar du byas pa'i lugs kyi/ rtse mo shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du bstan la snga ma'i rtse mos phyi ma'i rtsa ba gnon par dgram zhing*/ thab khung du rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang mi ring bas g.yog go /ku sha bkod tshar ba dang*/ rdor dril 'dzin pa'i lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol gdab bya/ de dag ni sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ bsang chus thab bsangs te/ las sngags brjaud/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ thab stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ saṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje 'dzin pa dkar po/ dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yul la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/

/thab kyi nang du raṃ las skyes pa'i me gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar raṃ las bgrang phreng*/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i rang 'od kyi rig ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sku/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na bgrang phreng*/ gnyis pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ gsum pa na gri gug /g.yon gyi dang po na dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ /gnyis pa na spyi blugs/ /gsum pa na thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar me gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dam tshig pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las spros pa'i khro bo 'dod rgyal gyis shar lho nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i me lha drang srong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drang par bsam la/ lag pa gnyis mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong g.yob cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung bo che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ thab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer gyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ sngags brjod cing bsang chu gtor la phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ 'og nas da lta nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ba ltar chu bzhi phul te/ oṃ mud ga ra dzaḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa dang nye bar dgug /oṃ daṇ+ḍa hūṃ kyis dam tshig pa la gzhug oṃ pad+ma baṃ kyis dbyer med du bcing*/ oṃ khaṅga hoḥ sa dbang du byas te/ rdor dril gyis 'khyud pa'i tshul dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya gnyis kyis se gol gtog pa sngon du 'gro bas gzhug pa sogs bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥ pra wa ra sad ka raṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā de bzhin du thog tha 'dra ba la āñca ma ṇaṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pa t+yaṃ zhes sbyar te gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu bzhi dbul zhing*/

oṃ ag+na ye ā di byā ā di byā ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ba ha nā ya badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas nyer spyod rol mo nang mchod dbul/ dril stabs dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ / thugs rjes dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal ba'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ /rig sngags gsung zhing bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan guṇ+ḍe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rts-i yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzā la dz+wa la ya/ sarba bhasmi ku ru/ sarba duṣ+ta na hūṃ phaṭa/ tri sh+yā dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig bsgrag go /de nas/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ yig dang dgang blugs kyi kha la ya yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur par bsam/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcings pa'i steng nas mthe bong bkab pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa'i mdzub mo brkyang ba gan rgyal du byas pas dgang gzar mar kyis bkang ba bzung*/ g.yas pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa kha thur du sbub la blugs gzar kyi yu ba bzung te/

g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'i thad kar g.yas pa'i khu tshur bzhag nas/ dgang gzar gyi khar blugs gzar gyi mgo bzhag nas 'dzin pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas lag pa gnyis pus mo'i nang nas phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor te/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par/ dgang blugs gsum mam/ bdun/ me lha'i sngags sam/ dgang blugs kyi sngags sam/ mar gyi sreg blugs kyi sngags la spel tshig btags la dbul te/ sngags dang po ni/ oṃ ag+na ye nas na yaḥ spel tshig 'og tu 'chad pa ltar ram/ sgrubs mchod sogs kyi skabs yin na/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrubs la bar du gcod pa dang*/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i bcas pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ na ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa la spel tshig sbyar ba dang*/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa la spel tshig sbyar ba'o/ /skabs 'dir me la bgegs yod med brtags nas/ yod na sel thabs sbyin sreg gi cho ga chen mor gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de nas yam shing ni dri zhim zhing tsher ma med pa'i 'o ma can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i phyogs srid du sor bcu gnyis pa/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad lo ma ma rnying ba/ rlan dang bcas pa mnyam por bcad cing ma gas pa/ rtse mo gnyis mar dang sprang rtsis byugs pa/ gnyis gnyis sbyar ba'am/ yang na rkyang ba/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rtse mo lha la bstan nas dbul zhing*/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/ par bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye ā di byā zhes pa nas/ bya ba ha nā ya oṃ bo dhi prik+ṣa ye/ bdag cag dpon slob ces pa nas/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/

yang na/ khyad par du yang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ lta bu gang 'dod de sbyor*/ de nas mar khu la/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa nas/ da ha nā ya/ oṃ ag+na ye/ bdag cag dpon slob nas/ 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad= til la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye/ bdag cag nas/ sdig pa thams cad= de nas dur ba gnyis gnyis sbyar nas dbul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ma ha nā ya/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ bdag cag nas/ che mthar phyin pa la bar du gcod pa*/ mas 'bras ma grugs pa la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+tā ye/ bdag cag nas/ bsod nams rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa= zho zan la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ sarba saṃ pā de/ bdag cag nas/ bde ba mchog la bar du gcod pa= ku sha gnyis gnyis sbyar nas dbul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye/ bdag cag nas/ bsrung ba mchog la bar du gcod pa dang*/ grib dang mi gtsang ba= yungs kar la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha na ya/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sidha ye/ bdag cag nas/ bgegs thams cad/ so ba la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye/ bdag cag nas/ nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad= nas la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye/ bdag cag nas/ myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad= sran ma la/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya/ bdag cag nas/ stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye sāhā/ de nas grol/ oṃ ag+na ye nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ badz+ra gha sma ri/ bdag cag nas/ bkra mi shis pa dang nad thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye sā hā/ gzhan yang zho 'o ma 'bras zan 'bras yos/ tsan+dan bri yang ku/ thang chu dri zhim po'i me tog rnams kyang 'dir me lha'i sngags dang*/ 'das pa'i skabs su lha gtso 'khor rang rang gi sngags kyis dbul lo/

/de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams snyan pa'i gdangs kyis phul nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ añca ma ṇaṃ/ zhes pas zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ āḥhīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ zhes pas bsang gtor dbul lo/ /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ mchod rdzas sger du yod na byin rlabs byas te/ thog mar lha bskyed pa ni/ sgrub mchod ma 'brel ba'i dbang du byas na/ me lha'i thugs kar me gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhir/ zhes pa nas/ ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi re mig dgu pa'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan zung re re/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ nang gi shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra'i yi ge bzhi 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba dang bcas pa/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyi mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi skur yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu/ zhes pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje'i gshed/ ces pa nas/ phyi'i grwa bzhin mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod cing*/ lha thams cad kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su sa snying gi rang bzhin k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ dkar po sogs sam yang na/ mig gnyis su k+ṣiṃ/ rna ba gnyis su dz+riṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lce'i rtsa bar raṃ/

dpral bar kaṃ /lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha bho ma hā kro dha zhes pa nas/ ku ru swāhā/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ /oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+ṝḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriḥṣ+t-iḥha zhes pa nas/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams de nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod cing*/ sngar gong du bshad pa ltar chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon nang mchod dang bcas pas mchod la/ gnyis med thun mongs ma yin zhes sogs kyis bstod/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ yig gis mtshan par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams dbul zhing*/ bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i sngon du thog mar/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag cag dpon slob ces pa nas/ bkra mi shis pa dang khyad par du yang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs bdun phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ 'phrin las mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba la grub na/ lha'i sngags dang*/ sreg rdzas ky-i sngags dang*/ spel tshig gsum ga sbyar nas/ bsreg rdzas re re 'bul/ bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo yam shing dang mar khu 'bul thebs re dang sngags re sbyar ba/ sbyin sreg re'i grangs su rtsi ba yin zhing*/ mar khu blugs gzar re rer bgrang bar bya'o/ /bsreg rdzas 'dul ba'i grangs ni/ bsreg blugs gcig gam/ gnyis gsum nas brgya stong gi bar gang rung ste/ de yang yam shing dang mar gtso bo yin bsam pa dang*/ gzhan rnams de las nyung ba dang*/

sdig pa zhi ba dgos pa gtso bo yin na til mang ba 'bul zhing*/ bgegs zhi ba la yungs kar dang tshe'i bar chad zhi ba don du gnyer na dur ba mang bar 'bul ba sogs shes par bya'o/ /lha'i sngags dang sbyor tshul ni/ oṃ hriḥṣ+t+ṝḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye/ bdag cag dpon slob ces sogs so/ / bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i cho ga gzhan thams cad sngar ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de'i tshe spel tshig ni sngar ltar skabs dang bstun nas 'bul tshul lha re re'am/ sde mtshan nam/ thams cad dkyus gcig la 'bul ba gang bde bya/ rgyas par na dang po ltar gtso 'khor rnams la lha rang rang gi sngags la spel tshig btags te/ bsreg rdzas rnams lha re re la gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba dbul lo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas bsgrub bya zla ba'i dkyil la gnas pa la khrus byas pas sdig sgrib nad gdon la sogs pa thams cad dag nas lus shel ltar dag par gyur/ buṃ chu blud pa'am mthor yang rung*/ mar khu dgang blugs bdun nam gsum la sogs pa gtso bo'i sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad sogs kyis mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor gsum dbul/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wa sa s+ya swā hā/ zhes pas gos gsar pa zung re me nang du dbul zhing*/ lha la na bza' phul bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi dbul/ de nas nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga rnams spro na tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyi 'bul/ de nas so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ btags la nang mchod dbul/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod de phyag byas nas/

oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ de nas lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i don du me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying khar sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyi pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /skabs 'dir bzod gsol 'di tsam gyi chog /oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes mang du brjod nas/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub bstsal/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa rnams bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa nas/ ba ha nā ya/ puṣ+paṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ ka bya ba ha nā ya oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo nang mchod dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor/ de bzhin du/ āñca ma ṇaṃ zhes pas zhal bsil/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ pu la swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi/ oṃ badz+ra wa sa s+ya swāhā/ zhes pas gos gsar ba rnams phul nas/ slar yang yaṃ shing nas bzung ste bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams gong du 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs su bshad pa ltar tshang mara'abul/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ āñca ma ṇaṃ pra ti ts+tsha swāhās zhal bsil/ de bzhin du/

pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor phul nas/ me lha'i sngags la puṣ+pe sogs sbyar te/ nyer spyod rol mo nang mchod rnams kyis mchod/ de nas gtor ma chang dang chu dang nang mchod kyis sbyangs te/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa nas/ ba ha nā ya/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nuta pan na twa da oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa gsum gyi gtor ma dbul/ /me lha'i sngags kyi mthar/ puṣ+paṃ sogs sbyar la sngar ltar mchod/ dril stabs dang bcas pas/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung*/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pratī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /zhes pa nas/ de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon zhing*/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ā:badz+ra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ /'dod na bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa bya'o/

/de nas gshin po'i spur sbyang byed tshul phan thogs che ba phal sreg gi dbang du byas te 'don cha gzhan sbyin sreg skams la kha 'phang zhing*/ dmigs bsal 'jug dgos pa rnams skabs de dang der 'jug tshul sa 'tshams bzung nas tshig nyung ngus go bder bshad par bya'o/ /sa gzhi stabs bde bar thab kyi 'og gzhi byas te mtha' nas shing khang gru bzhi ba rgyang khru do dang dpangs su khru gang sogs ci tsam 'tsham pa bya zhing de'i phyogs bzhir sgo dang*/ steng du spur khang rab byung la mchod rten lta bu dkar po/ rgyal po la gtsug tor lta bu sngon po/ blon po la za ma tog lta bu dmar skya/ dge bsnyen la pad+ma kha sbyar lta bu dmar po/ tha mal pa pho la gdan khri lta bu ser skya/ mo la bil pa lta bu sngo skya/ byis pa la lhung bzed lta bu dmar ser bya bar bu ston rin po ches bshad pas grub na de ltar bya'o/ /mkhas pa 'ga' zhig de thams cad myang 'das mchod rten gyi dbyibs su bya bar yang bshad de gang rung ngo*/ /de'i phyogs bzhir sgo chung bzhi dang*/ rdzas 'bul ba'i sgo ni kha'am snying ga'i thad du bya/ ro'i gnas yig ni 'jigs byed la mig gnyis su k+ṣi/ rna bar dziṃ sogs bris nas 'dogs pa'am mar sogs kyis sbyar zhing*/ gzhung che ba nas mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs dang kun rig gi rtsa rig gnyis gser ram/ dngul lam de bsres pa'i mtshal dang snag tshas ming spel sbyar te bris nas ro de'i mgo'am ske la btags na gshin po de nyid ngan song du mi 'gro bar bshad pas gnad che/ gzungs de gnyis bzlas pa'i bum chu lta bus ro legs par bkrus na'ang de bzhin du 'gyur bar bshad pas des bkru/ gzhan 'ga' zhig ni mthong rgyu las shes par bya'o/ /lho sgo sngon du byas pa yin na 'di nges par dgos pa min kyang*/ gzhan lho sgo byas te zas gtad kyi gong de'am/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi gong de'i bar du byas na'ang legs/

de nas rdor dril byin brlab sogs gzhung ltar la/ /me sbor ba'i tshe bsangs te/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ / phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba lnga yi me sbar ro/ /rkang ba dang po gnyis gzhan rnams ky-i thog mar sbyar ba'am/ /ma sbyar kyang chog pas/ 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi= dbang po drug gi= byang chub sems dpa'i= yul rnam drug gi= /lha mo drug gi= lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsum me spar ro/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ /'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /ces bu ston rin po ches bzhed pa ltar bya ste lan gcig gis chog /de nas gzi byin bskyed cing hūṃ gis spar nas gzugs stong pa'o/ /zhes pa nas sangs rgyas so'i bar brjod na legs/ /de nas dgang blugs bdun 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas me lha la dgang blugs gsum sogs phul ba'i rjes su/ me lha rdo rje las kyi gtso/ /tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyong ba dang*/ /lha rnams tshim par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du ni 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas me lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas tshe las 'das pa mdun du bkug ste de'i sdug bsngal dang*/ sdig sgrib nyes pa thams cad drangs nas spur dang sreg rdzas rnams la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ de nas yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam la/ sreg rdzas rnams rim par 'bul zhing*/ spel tshig rgyas pa'am 'jug pa bde chen thams cad la/ tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ gal te sbyin bdag kyang sbyor dgos pa byung na/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad kyang shin+taṃ ku ru ye sā hā/

zhes byed dgos pa la/ sku gshegs pa/ sa skyong*/ gnas brtan sogs gang 'grig sbyor/ de nas 'das lha la dgang blugs gsum sogs phul ba'i rjes der/ gtso bo dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang bcas kyis/ dmigs yul tshe 'das la sogs 'gro rnams la/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /brtse chen thugs rje chen pos legs bzung la/ sngon chad bsags pa'i sgrib pa gang mchis pa/ /bag chags bcas pa rab tu sbyang ba dang*/ srid dang rnam grol bde ba gang lags pa'i/ /dngos grub bde chen myur du stsal du gsol/ /ces gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas tshe las 'das pa mang du bkug nas de'i sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib nyes pa thams cad drangs te spur dang sreg rdzas rnam la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur ces brjod/ bsdu na des chog la/ rgyas par na ltung ba slong ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ā kar+ṣa ya bhi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ngan song gsum dang tshe 'das mdun du bkug par gyur/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ shodha ni sho ni sarba pā paṃ ā na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bkug par gyur/ sdig pa 'dral ba'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya zhes sogs dang*/ kaṃ ka ni/ dur ga ti dang*/ yig brgya bzhi ka'am gang rung bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra bhan+dha traṭa/ rdo rje bsdam pa dang sgra dang bcas pa lan gsum byas nas/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dral te spur dang sreg rdzas rnams la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ de nas phung po yon 'bul bya ba ni/ bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la/ /tshe 'das phung po mchod par 'bul/ /phung po'i sgrib pa ma lus pa/ /ye shes me yis sbyang du gsol/ /bcom ldan lha mo rnam bzhi la/ /tshe 'das 'byung bzhi=

/'byung ba'i= ye shes= bcom ldan sems dpa' rnam drug la/ tshe 'das dbang bo= dbang bo'i= ye shes= bcom ldan sems ma rnams bzhi la/ /tshe 'das yul rnams= yul gyi= ye shes= bcom ldan rgyal ba'i sku gsum la/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum= sgo gsum= ye shes me yis sbyang du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing zhes sogs kyi rjes su bsreg rdzas rnam rim par 'bul zhing*/ 'bul tshul ni gtso bo yab yum gnyis la mnyam du dang*/ gzhan rnams sde tshan nam/ dkyus gcig la 'bul zhing spel tshig ni sngar ltar ro/ /de nas phul tshar ba'i rjes su/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka zhes pa nas/ tshe 'das zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la khrus byas pas sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyang te tshe 'das de nyid hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ /dkon cog rin chen dpal zhing du/ zhes pa nas/ ma hā su kha ba ti gats+tsha n+tu swāhā/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes lha ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas bde ba can du gshegs par gyur zhes brjod cing bsams/ 'di nas nying 'tshams sbyar ma thag /zhes sogs kyi smon lam bya'o/ /de nas dgang blugs bdun 'bul ba sogs lhag ma la 'jug go /zhes pa 'di ni bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan re gnyis la phan ched 'jug pa bde bar bsgrigs pa'o// //sarba maṅgalaṃ// //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don 'khrigs chags su bkod pa phal sreg dang bcas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 168-- PAGE 167- -PAGE 165-
